subject: general
question: Which amendment added a chapter IV-A to Indian Constitution which consisted of only one Article 51-A that dealt with Fundamental Duties?
solution:
The correct answer is: **__42nd__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act of 1976** amended the Indian Constitution to include Fundamental Responsibilities.
 
• The **USSR is where the idea of fundamental obligations originated.**
 
• **Indian tradition, mythology, faiths, and traditions** are largely incorporated into the Fundamental Duties.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Every citizen should always be reminded of their **fundamental obligations** even though the constitution explicitly associates certain fundamental rights with them.
 
• Because **rights and duties** are related, it also calls for citizens to adhere to some fundamental democratic principles.
 
• The addition of **Basic Obligations brought our Constitution** into compliance with both the provisions of various other modern constitutions as well as article 29 (1) of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
